title: Input rows for one data-driven Arazzo workflow
description: Sits beside the Arazzo document whose workflow it feeds, named `<workflowId>.rows.yaml`; `workflow` repeats that workflow's case id. Each row binds the workflow's `inputs` by property name: a key the inputs schema does not name is refused, every `required` input is bound in every row, and each row validates against the inputs schema. An input of `format: uuid` with no value is generated per row. A value under a column `literals` names is a decision-table literal, and `validate` refuses one that does not parse against the literal grammar, naming its row, its column and the character offset of the production that fails. A `recipe` binds one more input per row from the row's literals, and the row it completes is what the inputs schema validates.

workflow.description: The case id of the workflow, `<document>/<workflowId>`.

iteration.description: `reset_per_row` runs each row against fresh preconditions; `single_pass` runs every row against one shared server state.

literals.description: The columns whose values are decision-table literals: a range `a..b`, a list `[x, y]`, a unit-scoped range `cm 5.0..10.0`, a terminology code `openehr::122 (length)`, an ordinal tuple `1|[local::at0005]`, a quantity `100 mg`, or a plain scalar. Each names an input the workflow declares.

recipe.description: The registered recipe that turns each row's literals into the value of one more input. `content_instance` builds the composition a content decision-table row commits: the `rm_class` value from the literal columns, in the minimal carrier composition stamped with `template_id`.

input.description: The workflow input the recipe binds; no row supplies it.
